name: cascadeflow-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is cascadeflow, a Python library for model cascading (answer with a cheap draft
model first and escalate to a stronger verifier model when the draft is not good enough), together with the cost
calculation and tracking, per-user budgets, tool-calling helpers, runtime harness, rate limits, guardrails and
circuit breakers around it.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code in scope is cascadeflow's cost, budget, tool and policy layer: the packages cascadeflow/telemetry/, cascadeflow/tools/, cascadeflow/pricing/, cascadeflow/limits/, cascadeflow/schema/, cascadeflow/harness/, cascadeflow/profiles/, cascadeflow/rules/, cascadeflow/guardrails/ and cascadeflow/resilience/. The documentation in scope is: docs/guides/cost_tracking.md, docs/guides/user-budget-tracking.md, docs/guides/tools.md, docs/guides/python_harness_quickstart.md, docs/guides/harness_telemetry_privacy.md, docs/api/telemetry.md, docs/api/python/config.md and docs/api/python/result.md, together with the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope packages.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evid
